## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The retry cap must be fixed before merge because it exceeds the pinned product requirement. Tests were read, not run.

## Changes
The pull request adds a retrying fetch helper and tests, and proposes increasing the policy cap from five attempts to ten.

## Critical
- app/net.py:13 — correctness — Cap default and accepted attempts at five — When an upstream repeatedly raises OSError, the default call makes ten attempts, violating `AGENTS.md:5`: “Retry helpers under app/ must cap attempts at 5.” The validation also accepts explicit values from six through ten. — During an upstream outage, callers generate twice the permitted request load before receiving the error.
